tools.name: resize_artboard
tools.description: Resize THIS existing document artboard in place; never creates a replacement. Required documentId, width/height (100–10000), expectedRevision from get_document. preserveContent defaults true: reject cropping visible scientific content, labels or attribution using existing measured bounds. false explicitly permits viewport clipping; all objects, coordinates and relationships remain stored. Uses existing undo/redo and live React sync. Full-bleed unlocked decorative backgrounds adapt to the new dimensions. Protected nonempty figures require installed Chromium. Call render_figure afterward to inspect PNG dimensions.

tools.name: render_figure
tools.description: Render an immutable saved document revision to PNG image content visible to Claude/Codex. Uses the existing vector exporter and installed Chromium; no UI overlays. Inspect the image, then analyze_figure_layout and apply_operations for visual refinement. Read-only. Returns requestedScale, actualScale, actualWidth/actualHeight, maxDimension and warnings when capped at 2048px; strictScale=true rejects capped/fractional requests. Use resize_artboard to change document dimensions, not scale.

tools.name: analyze_figure_layout
tools.description: Read-only browser-measured layout inspection: transformed arrow collisions/clearance, explicit versus ambiguous arrow labels, whitespace/artboard suggestions, glyph overflow, canvas margins, overlap and contrast. Returns diagnostics, safe proposed commands and a PNG for visual reasoning. Whitespace may be intentional. Call resize_artboard explicitly to apply chosen dimensions. Not a scientific/semantic image judgment; no mutations.

tools.name: refine_figure_layout
tools.description: Bounded render-inspect-correct loop through the shared undoable command engine. Default inspection-only; apply=true requires expectedRevision. Fit text, translate fitting roots, move proven unrelated labels and trim explicitly linked arrow endpoints. For an explicit artboard change, prefer the discoverable resize_artboard tool. The legacy resizeArtboard parameter remains supported with apply=true and expectedRevision and never crops content. Ambiguous relationships/complex intersections remain warnings; biological content is never inferred. Each pass is one undo step; returns remaining issues and PNG.

tools.name: compose_figure
tools.description: Compose a NEW editable document from the existing validated scientific figure-plan schema, render PNG, inspect and optionally correct conservative layout problems in at most 3 passes. Never replaces an existing figure. Use search_icons/get_asset first to choose licensed scientific icons. Claude supplies the scientific plan and interprets the returned image; no external AI API or scientific inference is performed.

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Create a persistent editable scientific document. Optional plan lays out an entire figure without coordinates. No external AI API is used.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Read the versioned document and its complete editable scene graph.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List locally stored documents with IDs and revisions.

tools.name: search_icons
tools.description: Semantic catalog search using scientific tags, taxonomy and curated synonyms plus full-text ranking. Returns paginated metadata; no assets downloaded from external providers.

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Inspect scientific asset metadata and provenance.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List scientific asset categories and subcategories.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List asset providers and distinct asset counts.

tools.name: list_imports
tools.description: Read recent local import progress and errors.

tools.name: list_icon_elements
tools.description: List editable SVG elements by original ID/key, fill, stroke, parent and transform. Read this before update_icon_element(s). Returns document revision and pagination.

tools.name: update_icon_element
tools.description: Update one SVG element. Preferred: documentId, objectId, elementId from list_icon_elements, patch {fill,stroke,strokeWidth,opacity}, optional expectedRevision. Null resets an override. Legacy change input remains supported. Source SVG stays immutable; supports undo/redo.

tools.name: update_icon_elements
tools.description: Atomically update SVG elements using changes [{elementId,patch:{fill,stroke,strokeWidth,opacity}}]. Legacy flat changes remain supported. One revision and undo transaction; invalid IDs reject the entire batch.

tools.name: list_svg_elements
tools.description: Inspect editable paths/groups on one SVG instance. Definition/use contents are excluded; keys are stable within the immutable asset.

tools.name: recolor_svg_element
tools.description: Set fill/stroke independently on an SVG path or group instance. Null removes that override. Preserves geometry; supports undo/redo.

tools.name: recolor_asset
tools.description: Recolor one SVG instance using exact palette values; library originals remain intact.

tools.name: add_icon
tools.description: Insert a catalog SVG as an editable transformable icon instance. Use search_icons to obtain iconId.

tools.name: add_shape
tools.description: Add an editable rectangle, rounded rectangle or ellipse.

tools.name: add_text
tools.description: Add editable text; newlines are preserved.

tools.name: add_arrow
tools.description: Add an editable arrow. Optional relationship records sourceId, targetId and labelIds for safe layout correction; points along local +X.

tools.name: update_object
tools.description: Update validated object properties or an invertible six-value affine transform; cannot change identity or parent. Style fields merge.

tools.name: delete_object
tools.description: Delete an object and all descendants in a single undoable transaction.

tools.name: group_objects
tools.description: Group sibling objects, preserving their current world placement.

tools.name: ungroup_objects
tools.description: Remove a group, preserving child world transforms.

tools.name: list_objects
tools.description: List a bounded page of objects, including hierarchy, transform, and style.

tools.name: export_svg
tools.description: Return standalone vector SVG for the saved document revision. Does not write an external file.

tools.name: apply_operations
tools.description: Apply an atomic batch through the shared document engine; useful for layout, multiple transforms and layer reordering.

tools.name: apply_figure_plan
tools.description: Replace document content from a structured scientific plan; deterministic topological layout needs no pixel coordinates. One undoable transaction.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo the last document transaction, including edits made by MCP or the UI.

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Redo the last undone transaction.
